# Volume VI: Procurement Execution, Subcontract Management, and Supply Chain

This volume focuses on vendor package RFQ development, commercial bid leveling across Incoterms 2020 and warranty boundaries, factory capacity reservation fees, post-award Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), FIDIC Silver Book Time Impact Analysis (TIA), and PUE performance liquidated damages.
